propositions: Three near-identical walkers that discover replacement links (iterating deps for duplicates, then inbound relationships for supersedes) must be consolidated into a single shared function to eliminate duplication and prevent behavioral divergence

The consolidated replacement_of function must preserve three distinct behavioral differences: find_replacement's DISPOSITION_CLASSES guard, _has_live_replacement_link's additional ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing for non-bugs, and _recorded_replacement_target's continue-on-subject-reduce-failure posture

The monkeypatch seams _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, and find_replacement must retain their exact names and signatures to prevent silent test failures when patched with raising=False
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be derived as an alias from DISPOSITION_CLASSES rather than restated independently, so the two sets cannot drift apart as happened in bug frolicky-dependable-peccary

The duplicates/supersedes walk (find_inbound_relationships in conjunction with supersedes) must appear only once in the codebase under src/rebar, guarded by a construct-uniqueness test that honors # replacement-walk-ok escape markers

All four existing pinning test suites (test_close_disposition_attestation_738a, test_close_gate_disposition_69b9, test_close_precheck_duplicate_link_c8fd, test_close_disposition) must pass without assertion edits and net code reduction must be achieved
